gate_results.notes: Authoritative Edit Mode run at the validated commit, Unity 6000.1.8f1, 63 of 63 passed, 0 failed, status passed, repository clean before and after, commit and tree unchanged across the run (557680f94 / 98906597f). The gate asks that visuals be checked against SEPARATELY OWNED collision and walkability geometry and that desynchronization be detected, and DoorPrototypeSceneBuilderTests asserts exactly that relation: Build_FloorTilemapVisual_AlignsWithIndependentGameplayFloorInWorldSpace and Build_WallTilemapVisuals_AlignWithIndependentGameplayWallsInWorldSpace compare Tilemap visuals against independently authored gameplay colliders in world space, so a visual/simulation divergence fails them. The sorting tests in the same fixture cover the SpriteRenderer half against that same Tilemap geometry.

Same authoritative run. FiveRoomCompositionTests opens the COMMITTED canonical scene Assets/Scenes/DoorPrototype.unity and asserts all five rooms are composed within that single continuous scene, which is what 'the foundation extends within the canonical continuous gameplay scene' requires. The no-room-transition half is satisfied structurally rather than by a dedicated assertion: the five rooms are present simultaneously in one scene, so no per-room scene load or cross-scene state transfer exists to introduce. Stated as an inference from the composition, not as a test that names scene loading.

human_approval.notes: NSC-040's two completion gates are both automated Unity validations and neither the gate text nor the contract names a human check, matching the NSC-063 and NSC-065 assistant-verified precedents. No human reviewed this and none is claimed. BASE COMMIT IS AN EDITORIAL CHOICE, NOT A DERIVATION, and is recorded as such: NSC-040 has NO implementation commit of its own - zero commits name it, and every commit touching its owned resources after its last dependency (NSC-039, validated d2add2488b) belongs to another task. Its siblings NSC-038 and NSC-039 both used the parent of their own implementation commit, which NSC-040 cannot do. The base given here is the parent of 1c4968c65 'Implement NSC-069: room scene composition foundation', chosen because that commit built the canonical continuous scene VAL-002 describes. THIS IS NOT A CLAIM THAT NSC-040 AUTHORED THAT COMMIT. base_commit is provenance only - its sole mechanical use is the ancestry check at record_delivery.py:596 - and no consumer reads it as a diff basis, so it cannot attribute another task's changes here. candidate_commit equals validated_commit for the same reason: there is no distinct implementation commit to name.
